lessons.title: Era of Sexual Liberation — Prince as Erotic Philosopher

body.text: Philosopher Goals: Teach sexuality + autonomy + politics. Prince wasn’t “nasty” for shock value. He was: “What emotions (not just sensuality) come through here?”

body.label: Key points
items: challenging Puritan ideas about Black desire
giving Black men permission to be soft, flamboyant, expressive
freeing women through his imagery & songwriting
using sexuality as metaphysics, not porn

lessons.title: The Business Revolutionary — “Artist Formerly Known As” Era

body.text: Formerly Known As” Era Goals: Teach ownership + industry politics. Prince’s battles: Lesson: Knowing your worth changes everything. This unit alone is life-changing for a Black kid.

body.label: Key points
items: changed his name to a symbol as protest
fought Warner Bros for master ownership
made direct artist-to-fan models before the internet
mentored others about ownership (Beyoncé, Alicia Keys)

finalProject.prompt: Explain how Prince revolutionized music through multi-instrument musicianship, genre fusion, and fearless self-expression. Compare When Doves Cry to a live performance (Purple Rain Super Bowl or ‘Baby I’m a Star’) and identify THREE modern artists who clearly carry Prince’s influence in either sound, visuals, or performance.
